campaign.title: Undo one functional equation on each diagonal transition trace

conductor_policy.monitoring: Work only on the two single-transition traces after subtracting the accepted endpoints, R1 residue, and renormalized sides. Preserve finite boxes and every outside residue/side.
conductor_policy.round_close: Close after a blind factorization, an analytic mixed-trace attack, a hostile audit, and graph adjudication.

resource_policy.literature_policy: Internal derivation first; primary-source search only for a theorem actually imported.

frozen_target.starting_formula: Use the exact Round-19 vector kernel and Round-20 diagonal gamma factorization, with the Round-21--24 endpoint/residue terms removed exactly once.
frozen_target.candidate: On beta=O(1), undo the bounded zeta factor and leave the large chi_4 factor transformed; on alpha=O(1), undo the bounded chi_4 factor and leave the large zeta factor transformed. Derive and estimate the resulting mixed arithmetic kernels.
frozen_target.success: Close at least one trace and isolate the other exactly, or prove a rigorous two-trace no-go for the proposed partial-FE mechanism.

campaign.promotion_policy: No trace is promoted from gamma asymptotics alone; require an exact arithmetic kernel and a uniform operator estimate.
